assets.name: 냉기 지대
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent Unity 2D mobile game HUD/inventory icon. All input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match the APPROVED reference art exactly: thick scratchy uneven black charcoal/wax-crayon outlines, deliberately simple naive doodle geometry, wax-crayon scribble fills with scattered white pigment gaps, flat colors. Reference 1 is the approved frost crystal; reference 2 the approved blue magic book; reference 3 the original game's UI sheet. Keep same line weight, level of simplicity, mottled crayons and palette. TRUE transparent alpha background, clean transparent corners. No shadows, no backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into image, no card/badge/frame, no labels, no text except a question mark when explicitly asked. No shiny rendering, 3D, polished vector curves or intricate fantasy decoration.
